premises.text: People fail at saving because brains are wired for impulse grabbing while retail preys on those instincts, and budget/spreadsheet diets do not work
premises.evidence_span: why do we suck so bad at it?

premises.text: ImpulseSave creates an FDIC-insured interest-bearing piggy bank linked to checking so money can move out of harm's way toward user goals
premises.evidence_span: they create an online piggy bank, a savings account that's FDIC-insured and interest-bearing

premises.text: At the moment of impulse, users can redirect the would-be spend into savings via mobile app (and later scan/SMS/Instagram/site)
premises.evidence_span: have the amount she was just about to have spent be transferred automatically in that moment into her ImpulseSave savings account

premises.text: Optional social sharing of impulse saves and a community feed reinforce the behavior
premises.evidence_span: close to 40% of our users choose to share their impulse saves

premises.text: Ninja marketing of goals via email, push, location notifications, and matching-fund incentives markets aspirations back to users
premises.evidence_span: we're going to use our ninja marketing skills to market those to you

value.text: Saving becomes as easy and instantly gratifying as spending, toward goals that matter
value.evidence_span: made it just as easy and as instantly gratifying to save your money as it is to spend it

causal_links.evidence_span: Most of us in America are actually spending between 10 and 20% of our disposable income on these silly purchases
You just saved $25 towards your trip to Paris
we're actually taking your goals, your aspirations, and your priorities in your life

notes: Hunting-gathering/retail impulse and failed budget products folded as one savings problem (§4.1.6). Account+goals+moment-of-impulse transfer folded as product cascade; multi-channel save surfaces folded as delivery of that mechanism (§4.1.7). Sharing and goal marketing kept as engagement modules. $3k saver metric treated as outcome evidence. Anti-template: problem, save product, and social/marketing loop separately revisable.
